entities.name: Marie-Ève Beauchemin-Nadeau
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marie-Ève Beauchemin-Nadeau is a Canadian Olympian weightlifter. She competed at the 2012 Summer Olympics in the -69 kg event and finished eighth. At the 2014 Commonwealth Games she won a gold medal in the 75 kg event with a 110 kg snatch and a 140 clean and jerk for a combined total of 250 kg, a Commonwealth Games record. She competed at the 2016 Summer Olympics in the same category, again finishing eighth, with a total of 228 kg.
